sloka: दत्ता ममेयं पित्रा तु लङ्का शून्या निशाचरैः ।निवासिते च मे यक्षैर्दानमानादिभिर्गुणैः ।। ७.११.३२ ॥
transliteration: dattā mameyaṁ pitrā tu laṅkā śūnyā niśācaraiḥ ।nivāsite ca me yakṣairdānamānādibhirguṇaiḥ ।। 7.11.32 ॥

translations.english: Kubera stated that his father had given him this Lanka, which was empty of Rakshasas, and he had settled it with Yakshas through various means like gifts and honors.
